labels.label: bzprop:c1s1p1_cartes_compatibles

hypotheses.paper: U an open set of V
hypotheses.note: U CONNECTED (IsPreconnected) for 1° and for the uniqueness in 2°; U nonempty for the uniqueness of g
IsAnalyticAction G X; instances for GSR n (wave 1) and GAR n (here)

findings: Prop. 1 (benzecri1960_ch1.tex:340–350) is false as printed for a disconnected open U: in the locally affine manifold ℝ¹ (connected, T2, second countable), U = {y < 1} ∪ {y > 2} carries two compatible charts — the identity, and the identity on {y < 1} glued to the translation by 10 on {y > 2} — which differ by no single g ∈ GA(1, ℝ) (1° fails) and have the same jet at 0 without being equal on U (uniqueness in 2° fails): not_prop1_of_disconnected. True with U connected (existsUnique_smul_eq_of_isPreconnected, existsUnique_compatibleChart_jet); 2°'s existence holds for every U (exists_compatibleChart_jet). The proof « résulte facilement du 2° de la définition 12 » uses connectedness implicitly.
questions: Uniqueness in 2° is up to OpenPartialHomeomorph.EqOnSource (equal on U), since an OpenPartialHomeomorph carries values outside its source.
